WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    c.state_county_province,
    SUM(ft.transaction_amount) as state_total
  FROM Financial_Transactions ft
  JOIN Invoices i ON ft.invoice_number = i.invoice_number
  JOIN Orders o ON i.order_id = o.order_id
  JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  GROUP BY c.state_county_province
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(state_total) as grand_total
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.state_county_province,
    s1.state_total,
    s1.state_total / s2.grand_total as percentage
  FROM step1 s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 s2
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(percentage) as avg_percentage
  FROM step3
),
step5 AS (
  SELECT 
    s3.state_county_province,
    s3.state_total,
    s3.percentage,
    s3.percentage - s4.avg_percentage as diff
  FROM step3 s3
  CROSS JOIN step4 s4
  WHERE s3.percentage > s4.avg_percentage
)
SELECT 
  SUM(state_total),
  AVG(percentage),
  AVG(diff)
FROM step5
